lesson.title: Procedure 200 – RADIO DISPATCHER CONTROL PANEL
lesson.topic: Radio Dispatching – Console Controls, Audio Routing, and Interrupt Rules
objectives: Explain the purpose of Procedure 200 and what the MCC 7500 dispatch console provides.
Identify on-screen controls (padlock, transmit, 10-13, steady alert, time display, zone box, VU meter).
Apply alert-tone rules including duration limits and where tones are heard.
Explain speaker/headset behavior and audio routing during telephone calls.
Apply foot pedal transmit use and interruption rules for field units versus other console positions.
